title: Tech Builder Tee
descriptionHtml:
Joy's tee, and Joy is the one always halfway through the next idea. The print runs on gaming energy: LEVEL UP, NEXT GEN ENERGY and OWN YOUR GAME, scattered with sticker-style doodles. LEVEL UP turns up across the back as well. Four colourways in all.

The cotton is 100% organic, the inks OEKO-TEX certified, the tee BIS certified. Sized for ages four to twelve. It handles a controller, a football and whatever gets spilled at lunch.

title: Smart Tech Tee
descriptionHtml:
This one belongs to Jevika and Joy, the two children the shop is named after. It is a tee for a curious sort of day: questions, experiments, and the quiet stretch where a child is busy figuring something out. Boys and girls, ages 4 to 12, in five colours, from black and blue to peach.

The cotton is 100% organic, the inks are OEKO-TEX certified, and the tee is BIS certified. Soft enough to live in, and steady through a school day and the sprawl on the floor after it.

title: Curious Girl Tee
descriptionHtml:
The Curious Girl Tee belongs to Jevika, the girl with dark pigtails and red bows. It is an everyday tee for a child who asks questions, and then asks better ones. Four colourways, so there is one for most moods.

The cotton is 100% organic and the inks are OEKO-TEX certified, with BIS certification behind the make. Sizes run from age four to twelve. It takes a school day, a scooter in the park and a long afternoon indoors without complaint.

title: Adventure Tee
descriptionHtml:
Pinki asks why, then asks again. She is the squirrel in the round glasses, and this is her tee: a compass on the front with STAY CURIOUS in sticker lettering beside it. Four colourways, pink through to black.

The cotton is 100% organic and BIS certified, the inks OEKO-TEX certified. Sizes run 4 to 12. It is made for the kind of day that starts tidy and ends with grass stains, a pocketful of pebbles and a question you cannot answer.

title: Skate Life Tee
descriptionHtml:
This one belongs to Joy, the boy of the Jevika & Joy's World cast and an Adventure Squad regular, usually found where there is a bit of speed to be had. An everyday tee for boys aged 4 to 12, in three colourways.

The cotton is 100% organic, the inks are OEKO-TEX certified, and the tee is BIS certified. Soft from the first wear, and dressed for a park afternoon, a kerb, and a long sit on the front step afterwards.

title: Brutus Boxer Tee
descriptionHtml:
A soft everyday tee from Jevika & Joy's World, printed with Joy and Brutus the boxer dog, plus Adventure Squad in sticker lettering. The two of them go everywhere together, which is roughly the arrangement most children already have with a best friend. It comes in four colourways.

The cotton is 100% organic, the inks are OEKO-TEX certified, and the tee is BIS certified. Sizes run age four to twelve. Built for park mornings, muddy knees and the long walk home.

title: Street Tee
descriptionHtml:
A Jevika & Joy's World tee, and this one belongs to Joy. Street games, park football, the stretch between school and dinner when nobody is sitting down. It suits a child who is always halfway out of the door.

The cotton is 100% organic, the inks are OEKO-TEX certified, and the tee carries BIS certification. It comes in three colourways and in sizes for ages 4 to 12. Black is there for the days that end muddy.

title: Friends Tee
descriptionHtml:
A tee from Jevika and Joy's World for the outdoor half of the day. It belongs to Jevika and Joy, the two at the centre of every street game and stray football. Made for running about, cycling and whatever the park turns into by evening.

Cut from 100% organic cotton and printed with OEKO-TEX certified inks, in three colourways from pink through to white. BIS certified, sized for ages 4 to 12, and made for the kind of day that runs from the school gate to dinner.

title: Giggles Tee
descriptionHtml:
WILD AT HEART sits across the front, with Minku's sticker doodles scattered around it. Minku is the monkey of the Jevika & Joy's World cast, and this one is his. Made for boys and girls.

100% organic cotton, BIS certified, printed with OEKO-TEX certified inks. Sizes run 4 to 12 years across six overlapping ranges, and there are six colourways. It is a tee for monkey bars, sports day and the week it becomes the only shirt they will wear.

title: Wander Tee
descriptionHtml: A soft everyday tee from Jevika & Joy's World, printed with a compass, mountains and the reminder that not all who wander are lost. Built for playgrounds, art class and everything after.
